name: boringstack-ui
description: Production-grade SPA starter (Vite + React + TypeScript) for the BoringStack family. Wired with shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, Zustand, react-router, RHF + Zod, i18next, Storybook, Playwright, and 8 custom ESLint plugins enforcing the architecture.

scripts.validate: bun run check && bun run test:ci && bun run build && bun run size:check && bun run size:check:modulepreload && bun run check:size-budget
scripts.validate:full: bun run validate && bun run e2e:ci
scripts.analyze: ANALYZE=true bun run build && open dist/stats.html
scripts.release: bun run validate && changeset tag && git push --follow-tags
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run lint:meta && bun run check:lint-meta-docs && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run knip

//overrides._: Why these transitive deps are pinned. Dev tooling only — lighthouse/lhci and http-server pull the vulnerable ranges; production output is a static bundle. Astro-only build deps (e.g. devalue, GHSA-77vg-94rm-hx3p) are pinned in apps/docs, not here — the Vite toolchain does not pull them.
//overrides.body-parser: Pin patched body-parser (GHSA-v422-hmwv-36x6). 1.20.5 is vulnerable; 1.20.6 patches it. Transitive via @lhci/cli (CI-only).
//overrides.js-yaml: Pin patched js-yaml (GHSA-52cp-r559-cp3m, GHSA-5p4m-2wfm-xmqj, GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh). 4.3.1 and earlier are vulnerable; 4.3.2 patches the maxTotalMergeKeys CPU-exhaustion case. Build-time config loading only.
//overrides.postcss: Pin patched postcss (GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849, GHSA-fxqj-rqcc-2cmp). 8.5.18 is vulnerable; 8.5.23 patches it. Build-time CSS tooling via vite/tailwind.
//overrides.seroval: Pin patched seroval (GHSA-p6vx-979v-rg4c, GHSA-jp82-f5mq-hwhp). 1.5.6 is vulnerable; 1.6.3 patches both. Reached only through solid-js under @tanstack/react-query-devtools, which is not in the production bundle. solid-js 1.9.16 moves to ~1.6.8 itself; drop this pin once it passes the release-age quarantine.
//overrides.seroval-plugins: Moves with the seroval pin above; seroval-plugins declares a peer on the matching seroval line.
//overrides.ws: Pin patched ws (GHSA-58qx-3vcg-4xpx) pulled via lighthouse dev tooling; mirrors the docs app pin.
//overrides.qs: Pin patched qs (GHSA-q8mj-m7cp-5q26, GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g, GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx). 6.15.2 is vulnerable; 6.16.0 patches it. Pulled via dev tooling; mirrors the docs app pin.
//overrides.tmp: Pin patched tmp (GHSA-7c78-jf6q-g5cm type-confusion path traversal); 0.2.6 is now vulnerable, 0.2.7 patches it. Transitive dev-tooling dep via @lhci/cli. Mirrors the docs app pin.
//overrides.undici: Pin patched undici (GHSA-vmh5-mc38-953g TLS cert-validation bypass, GHSA-pr7r-676h-xcf6, the 7.29.0 batch: GHSA-4cwx-7wf7-3272, GHSA-8xcm-r25x-g524, GHSA-jr45-8vmc-qm54, GHSA-m8rv-5g2x-5cg5, GHSA-v3r7-h72x-cjcm, and GHSA-3wwx-pv8p-q78v plus the 7.29.0 advisories fixed in 7.29.1); pulled in transitively by jsdom (test environment only). 7.29.1 is the patched release. Mirrors the docs and site app pins.
//overrides.basic-ftp: Pin patched basic-ftp (GHSA-c475-qrg2-pj4r, CPU exhaustion parsing a directory listing). 5.3.1 is vulnerable; 6.2.1 patches it. Transitive via proxy-agent -> get-uri in the puppeteer / Lighthouse CI tooling; 6.0's only break (separate transfer hosts off by default) does not touch get-uri's use. Mirrored by apps/docs.
//overrides.compression: Pin patched compression (GHSA-vc2v-76pw-4v95). 1.8.1 is vulnerable; 1.8.2 patches it. Transitive via dev/CI server tooling (http-server, Lighthouse CI); never in the static bundle.
//overrides.ip-address: Pin patched ip-address (GHSA-2vr4-cq9g-pvrc, GHSA-rpw4-54j3-4h4q, GHSA-h3mg-xc3c-68pw, GHSA-j6r3-76f7-8jcv). 10.4.0 is vulnerable; 10.7.2 patches them. Transitive via proxy-agent -> socks and express-rate-limit in the puppeteer / Lighthouse CI tooling. Mirrored by apps/docs.
//overrides.proxy-addr: Pin patched proxy-addr (GHSA-jqcg-44mw-7w3h). 2.0.7 is vulnerable; 2.0.8 patches it. Transitive via express in @lhci/cli (CI-only).
//overrides.shell-quote: Pin patched shell-quote (GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv). 1.10.0 is vulnerable; 1.11.0 patches it. Transitive via launch-editor (dev tooling).
//overrides.smol-toml: Pin patched smol-toml (GHSA-r4xh-jqrq-34v2). 1.8.0 is vulnerable; 1.9.0 patches it. Transitive via knip (lint-time only). Mirrored in every app by the override-parity rule.
//overrides.source-map-js: Pin patched source-map-js (GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q). 1.2.1 is vulnerable; 1.2.2 patches it. Transitive via postcss / css-tree build tooling. Mirrored in every app by the override-parity rule.
//overrides.@types/react: Single React types resolution across the workspace.
//overrides.@types/react-dom: Single React DOM types resolution across the workspace.
//overrides.@typescript-eslint/utils: Match the API app's pin so the shared ESLint plugins resolve one utils version.
//overrides.react: Single React runtime across the workspace. zustand declares react as an exact-pinned optional peer, so without this it keeps its own nested copy when the top-level react bumps — two React instances break hooks ("Cannot read properties of null (reading 'useCallback')") in tests. Keep in lockstep with the react dependency.
//overrides.react-dom: Mirror the react pin so the renderer never drifts from React itself ("mismatching versions of React and the renderer").
